repairAction: Attach an audited reference-completeness inventory with per-species depth, close relatives and geographic coverage.
Resolve sequence QC failures (ambiguity, complexity, orientation/ORF or chimera evidence) before species-level use.
Add assay evidence fields: controls, primers, replicate/QC or qPCR/ddPCR quantification metadata as applicable.
Add high-priority DNA-derived extension fields: eventID, materialSampleID, pcr_primer_forward, pcr_primer_reverse, seq_meth.
Publish the molecular assignment at genus rank unless additional evidence resolves the ambiguity.
Use a longer/cleaner marker sequence or treat the assignment below species rank.
Complete required Darwin Core Occurrence core fields before GBIF publication.
